Numerical kernels for posterior draws. See Posterior draws for shapes, tolerances, and failure behavior.

Kernels

draws_moments()

Weighted draw mean and covariance; weights normalized internally. Normalization ‘population’ or ‘unbiased’ (reliability weights, never frequency counts). Singular covariance is valid. Rows are draws; columns are parameters. Preserves iteration order; no row deletion or intercept insertion. null/NAN/INF and nonnumeric elements are rejected.

Phit\draws_moments(    array $draws,    ?array $weights = NULL,    string $normalization = 'population',): array
Parameter Type Default Description
$draws array required Draws: one row per draw and one column per parameter
$weights ?array NULL Nonnegative weights, one per draw, normalized internally; null weights draws equally
$normalization string 'population' ‘population’ or ‘unbiased’ (reliability weights)

Returns array{mean: list<float>, covariance: list<list<float>>}

Errors Input/numerical error (codes 1001–1005).

See also Details

draws_covariance_map()

Cholesky/triangular-solve map A: A * source * A^T = target. Finite symmetric positive-definite covariances of equal size; tolerances in docs/draw-numerics.qmd. Failure is explicit; no regularization. Rows are draws; columns are parameters. Preserves iteration order; no row deletion or intercept insertion. null/NAN/INF and nonnumeric elements are rejected.

Phit\draws_covariance_map(    array $sourceCovariance,    array $targetCovariance,): array
Parameter Type Default Description
$sourceCovariance array required Symmetric positive-definite covariance of the source draws
$targetCovariance array required Symmetric positive-definite target covariance, of the same size

Returns array{matrix: list<list<float>>, log_abs_det: float}

Errors Input/numerical error (codes 1001–1005).

See also Details

draws_affine()

Apply y = Ax + b to each draw: Y = XA^T + b. Square invertible A; return log(abs(det(A))). Numerical rank tolerance in docs/draw-numerics.qmd. Rows are draws; columns are parameters. Preserves iteration order; no row deletion or intercept insertion. null/NAN/INF and nonnumeric elements are rejected.

Phit\draws_affine(    array $draws,    array $matrix,    array $shift,): array
Parameter Type Default Description
$draws array required Draws: one row per draw and one column per parameter
$matrix array required Square invertible matrix A
$shift array required Shift b, one value per parameter

Returns array{draws: list<list<float>>, log_abs_det: float}

Errors Input/numerical error (codes 1001–1005).

See also Details
